recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future publisher regression causes the ValueSet header description to display raw [[[CodeSystem]]] or Markdown link syntax instead of rendered links.
issue_request: FHIR-16378 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary change request for the ValueSet resource page. It reported that links for code system and coded elements terminologies were missing in section 4.8, and Jira records the resolution as auto-approved.
initial_application: Jira records GH#111133ddac as the application. That commit changed the old publisher PageProcessor so resource page definitions were processed through processMarkdown rather than inserted raw, addressing the symptom of [[[CodeSystem]]] and [coded elements](terminologies.html) markup appearing unrendered in the ValueSet header.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml contains the requested CodeSystem and coded-elements links in both the resource description and root element definition, and build.fhir.org currently renders those terms as real anchors. FHIR-18560 is the same ValueSet header link change family and already has a no-change audit commit on the combined branch, so it was not duplicated here. Corrected Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source and the current rendered publication surface already satisfy the non-substantive link correction requested by FHIR-16378.
